notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: We improved the ability to catch spawned balls in Court and High Hoops mode!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
[i]New game mode:   [b]High Hoops [/b] [/i]
[i]New characters: [b]Carrot guy, Pumpkid, Watermelone [/b] [/i]
[i][b]New Leaderboard system [/b] [/i]

[i]Try out the new High Hoops, many hoops to shoot at, but there's a catch - figure out how to remove those hands blocking them and keep up!

Our new characters are adorable and we hope you enjoy playing with them!

The leaderboard is a big update, now you can compete with the rest of the world and be the very best at Basketball Madness!! Be sure to select your country flag as well!  [/i] 

[i][b]And of course stay tuned for more levels, characters and updates! Don't forget to wishlist us! :) [/b] [/i]
